content.value_statement: Manual spreadsheet entry is slow and inconsistent. This skill appends simple or structured rows to a selected Google Sheets range through gws.
actual_capabilities: Appends one row using comma-separated values.
Appends multiple rows using structured JSON values.
Selects the destination spreadsheet by its identifier.
Targets a sheet tab or range with A1 notation.
Requests user confirmation before executing the write command.
limitations: Requires the gws command-line tool and its shared authentication guidance.
Requires permission to write to the selected Google spreadsheet.
Does not document reading, updating, formatting, or deleting existing cells.
Comma-separated input is intended for simple strings; structured input is needed for bulk rows.

use_cases.title: Record Sales Leads
use_cases.description: Append a confirmed lead record to a shared tracking spreadsheet.

use_cases.title: Add Research Results
use_cases.description: Insert several collected observations into a designated worksheet range.

use_cases.title: Log Project Updates
use_cases.description: Add dated status entries to a team reporting sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Append One Row
prompt_templates.prompt: Append these values to spreadsheet [ID]: [values]. Ask for confirmation before writing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a simple row to the first sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Sheet Tab
prompt_templates.prompt: Append [values] to range [Sheet2!A1] in spreadsheet [ID]. Confirm the destination and values first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Target a specific worksheet with A1 notation.

prompt_templates.title: Append Multiple Rows
prompt_templates.prompt: Append these rows to spreadsheet [ID]: [rows]. Validate their column count and ask for confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Insert a small batch of structured records.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Verified Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [rows] for consistent columns, target [range] in spreadsheet [ID], summarize the write, then request confirmation before appending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate and append a controlled batch to a named range.

output_examples.input: Add Alice, 100, and true to the first sheet after confirmation.
output_examples.output: Prepared one row for the selected spreadsheet: Alice | 100 | true. The write awaits your confirmation.

output_examples.input: Append two inventory records to the Inventory sheet.
output: Validated two rows with matching columns.
Target: Inventory sheet, starting at A1.
The append operation awaits your confirmation.

output_examples.input: Log the current project status in the Status sheet.
output_examples.output: Appended the confirmed status row to the Status sheet and reported the completed write.

best_practices: Verify the spreadsheet identifier, target range, and row values before confirmation.
Use structured values for multiple rows or values containing commas.
Confirm that every row has the expected number and order of columns.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a write without explicit user confirmation.
Do not place sensitive data in a spreadsheet without checking access permissions.
Do not use simple comma-separated values for complex or ambiguous data.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It appends new rows to a selected Google spreadsheet. It does not document changing or deleting existing rows.

faq.question: What information is required?
faq.answer: Provide a spreadsheet identifier and row values. A target range is optional.

faq.question: Can it append multiple rows?
faq.answer: Yes. Use structured row values for batch inserts.

faq.question: Can it target a specific sheet tab?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the destination in A1 notation, such as Sheet2!A1.

faq.question: Does it require confirmation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to confirm with the user before executing the write.

faq.question: What setup is needed?
faq.answer: Install gws and follow the shared skill guidance for authentication, global flags, and security rules.
